manifest.name: dsh-whale-chase-rice
manifest.description: A text-burden chibi whale-girl runner: jump life’s word obstacles and reach the rice bowl.
manifest.author: Big Fat Fish contributors

readme.section: 大肥鱼想吃饭 · Big Fat Fish Wants to Eat
readme.text: [](https://github.com/Fr20210478/dsh-whale-chase-rice/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [中文](#chinese) | [English](#english) 一个住在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 浮窗里的小鲸鱼娘跑酷，用来填满等 AI 回答的那几分钟：跳过生活里的糟心事，冲到大碗白米饭，回答好了会有提示。 | 胜利结算 | 失败结算 | 终点米饭 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |

- **随时可玩**：AI 空闲、正在回答、刚回答完都能开一局；单局可选 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 3 分钟。
- **一个键**：空格 / ↑ / W / 点击 / 触屏点击跳跃。撞到词就结束，冲到大碗白米饭就是通关。
- **只有文字的生活障碍**：加班、内卷、PUA、内耗、焦虑、失眠、脱发、肥胖、贫穷、长痘、生病（英文模式显示 OT / RACE / PUA / BURN / ANX / SLEEP / HAIR / FAT / DEBT / ACNE / SICK）。纯文字、随机颜色、无边框无底板、不倾斜；每个障碍宽高随机，间距随机，并且用可达性规则保证下一跳一定跳得过去。障碍会随跳跃高度和本局进度变大。
- **米饭一直看得见**：从第一帧就停在右侧，整局慢慢靠近，最后 5 秒加速冲向鲸鱼娘。
- **结算对话框**：胜利 / 失败各有一张插画；关闭对话框会回到暂停的起始页，不会自动重开。
- **暂停 / 继续 / 重新开始**；拖动标题栏可以移动游戏卡片。
- **圆形可拖动浮窗**：带鲸鱼娘头像的圆形按钮，默认在右侧、从上往下 1/5 处；拖到任意位置后会按“最近边缘 + 纵向比例”记住，切换全屏/改变窗口大小时不会跑偏。有未读回答时出现一个小圆点，没有闪烁光效。
- **回答好提示**：游戏区上方出现 `回答好了` 提示条；开着音效时会响提示音。正在跑的这一局不会被强行打断。
- **中英文界面**，在设置里切换。
- **防沉迷可选，默认关闭**：温和档为 3 局 → 休息 30 秒、每次等待最多玩 5 分钟、每天最多 60 分钟、回答完成后 5 秒冷却、达到每日 80% 时轻提示。
- **音效默认关闭**。
- 不联网、无遥测、无第三方运行时依赖；所有设置存在浏览器 `localStorage`。

前提：已安装 DeepSeek Harness，并且带 Web UI（桌面版自带 Web UI；本项目在桌面版 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上开发验证）。

DSH 插件页的「添加插件」接受三种地址：**npm 包名**、**GitHub 仓库地址**、**本地目录路径**。本插件现在可以用后两种安装；npm 包名要等发布后才可用（见下）。

readme.section: 方式一：在 DSH 界面里安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 打开 DSH 侧边栏的「插件」页，点「添加插件」。
2. 在「包名或地址」输入框里填 GitHub 仓库地址：`https://github.com/Fr20210478/dsh-whale-chase-rice`
3. 点「安装」，装好后按提示重启 DSH。对话面板右侧会出现圆形鲸鱼娘头像。

readme.section: 方式一：在 DSH 界面里安装（推荐）
readme.text:
> 「添加插件」的输入框也接受 **npm 包名**和**本地目录路径**。**插件包名就是 npm 包名**：形如 `dsh-xxx` 或 `@作者/插件名`，也就是社区插件 README 安装命令里 `dsh plugin add` 或 `pnpm add` 后面那一段（示例：`dsh-plugin-whale-pet`）。
>
> 本插件目前只通过 GitHub 分发；计划使用的 npm 包名是 `dsh-whale-chase-rice`，但**尚未发布到 npm**，所以现在请填上面的 GitHub 地址。等发布到 npm 后，也可以直接填这个包名，由 DSH 按「安装源」下载。
>
> 填 GitHub 地址或 `.tgz` 直链时不经过安装源，需要本机能直接访问 GitHub；如果访问不了，可以改用本地目录安装。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Fr20210478/dsh-whale-chase-rice
```

把 `web` 换成你要安装到的 profile（Web UI 一般是 `web`）。桌面版正在运行时不能对它执行 `dsh plugin`，请先用上面的界面安装。

readme.section: 方式三：本地目录（开发 / 改代码时）
readme.text:
克隆仓库后，用 Harness 的插件管理器 `install_bundle` 指向**仓库根目录**（`package.json` 所在目录），或在「添加插件」里直接填这个目录的绝对路径。重启 Harness 后生效。需要移除时，在插件页卸载，或对 `dsh-whale-chase-rice` 执行 `remove_bundle`。

> **升级**：插件页里没有「更新」按钮的插件，需要先卸载再安装新版本。
>
> **没出现头像？** 到「插件」页确认这个 bundle 已安装并启用，然后重启 DSH。

- 拖动圆形头像移动它；单击打开游戏。
- 拖动游戏卡片标题栏移动卡片；`Esc` 关闭，`P` 暂停。
- 齿轮里设置：音效、语言、单局时长、防沉迷、统计重置、最佳分数重置。
- AI 回答好时，如果正在玩，这一局继续，提示条出现在游戏区上方；如果窗口收起且你玩过，会重新弹出并响一次提示音（音效开启时）。

`assets/` 下的 `whale`、`victory`、`failure`、`rice` 四个基名，支持 `.png / .jpg / .jpeg / .webp`；构建时**取每个基名最新的文件**，因此替换图片不需要改代码：

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs   # 把最新图片内联进 client.js

npm run watch
```

**只替换文件不会改变正在运行的插件**：图片是在构建时内联进 `client.js` 的，必须先重新构建，再重新安装 / 重启 Harness（客户端热更新可用时会自动加载，否则需要重启）。建议尺寸：`whale` 512px 透明底、`victory` / `failure` 384px 透明底、`rice` 420px 透明底。详见 [`assets/README.md`](assets/README.md)。

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/ + assets/ -> client.js
node --test              # 29 个测试：游戏规则、防沉迷、bundle、界面
npm pack --dry-run       # 检查最终会发布到 npm 的文件列表
```

`client.js` 里的模块 id 和版本号都从 `package.json` 读取，改包名或版本号后重新构建即可。

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 半（空实现） |
| `src/core.js` | 纯游戏 / 防沉迷规则 |
| `src/render.js` | Canvas 场景、文字障碍、Q 版动画 |
| `src/client.template.js` | React 浮窗、启动器、对话框、设置 |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | 把所有源码拼成 `client.js` |
| `test/` | `node:test` 测试 |
| `locale/` | 插件管理器展示元数据（中 / 英） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插件行声明（`name` 即 npm 包名） |
[MIT](LICENSE)。`assets/` 里的鲸鱼娘插画是为本项目生成的；如果二次分发时想换形象，替换 `assets/` 即可。 ---

A tiny chibi whale-girl runner that lives in a floating window of the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web UI. It fills the minutes
you spend waiting for the AI: jump the burdens of work life, reach the bowl of
rice, and get a nudge when the answer is ready.

| Victory | Failure | The goal |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |

- **Playable any time**, not only while the AI is replying. Runs are 0.5, 1, 2
  or 3 minutes long.
- **One input.** Space / ↑ / W / click / tap to jump. Hit a word and the run
  ends; reach the rice bowl for the victory dialog.
- **Text-only burdens**: 加班, 内卷, PUA, 内耗, 焦虑, 失眠, 脱发, 肥胖, 贫穷, 长痘,
  生病 (OT / RACE / PUA / BURN / ANX / SLEEP / HAIR / FAT / DEBT / ACNE / SICK in
  English). No outline, no chip fill, no rotation; random medium colours. Size
  and spacing are rolled per obstacle, a passability rule guarantees the next
  jump is possible, and burdens grow with the jump height and over the run.
- **The rice bowl is always in sight**: it waits at the right edge, drifts
  closer very slowly, then rushes toward the whale girl during the last five
  seconds.
- **Result dialogs** with the supplied illustrations. Closing a dialog returns to
  the paused start screen — it never auto-restarts.
- **Pause / resume / restart**; drag the card by its title bar.
- **Circular draggable launcher** with the whale-girl avatar; it defaults to the
  right edge, one fifth down. Positions are remembered as "nearest edge +
  vertical ratio", so fullscreen and window resizes keep the same relative

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (the desktop app bundles one;
this project is developed and tested against the desktop app, `0.2.1-rc.2`).

The plugin page's **Add plugin** field accepts three kinds of spec: an **npm
package name**, a **GitHub repository address**, or a **local directory path**.
For this plugin, use the last two for now; the npm package name becomes usable
once it is published (see below).

readme.section: Option 1: install from the DSH UI (recommended)
readme.text:
1. Open the **Plugins** page in the DSH sidebar and click **Add plugin**.
2. In **Package name or address**, enter the GitHub repository address:
   `https://github.com/Fr20210478/dsh-whale-chase-rice`
3. Click **Install** and restart DSH when prompted. The circular whale-girl
   launcher appears at the right edge of the Conversation panel.

readme.section: Option 1: install from the DSH UI (recommended)
readme.text:
> The **Add plugin** field also accepts an **npm package name** and a **local
> directory path**. **The plugin package name is the npm package name** — like
> `dsh-xxx` or `@author/plugin`. It is the part after `dsh plugin add` or
> `pnpm add` in a community plugin's README install command (example:
> `dsh-plugin-whale-pet`).
>
> This plugin is currently distributed only through GitHub; the planned npm
> package name is `dsh-whale-chase-rice`, but it is **not published to npm
> yet**, so use the GitHub address above for now. Once the npm package exists,
> entering that package name downloads it through the selected **Registry**.
>
> A **GitHub address** or `.tgz` link is fetched directly and does not go
> through the registry, so this machine must reach GitHub itself; if it cannot,
> install from a local directory instead.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Fr20210478/dsh-whale-chase-rice
```

Replace `web` with the profile you want. The desktop app owns its profile and
must be fully quit before `dsh plugin` can modify it — while it is running, use
the UI route above.

Clone the repository, then point the harness plugin manager (`install_bundle`)
at the **repository root** (the directory containing `package.json`), or enter
that absolute path in **Add plugin**, and restart Harness. Remove it later by
uninstalling it on the Plugins page or by calling `remove_bundle` for
`dsh-whale-chase-rice`.

> **Upgrades**: plugins with no Update button on the Plugins page must be
> uninstalled and reinstalled to move to a newer version.
>
> **No launcher?** Check that the bundle is installed and enabled on the
> Plugins page, then restart DSH.

- Drag the circular avatar to move it; click it to open the game.
- Drag the card by its title bar. `Esc` closes it, `P` pauses.
- Settings: sound, language, run length, anti-addiction, reset stats / best.
- When the AI finishes while you are playing, the run keeps going and the answer
  strip appears above it. If the window was closed and you had played, it
  reopens and the chime fires once (when sound is on).

Replace any of `whale`, `victory`, `failure`, `rice` in `assets/` with
`.png / .jpg / .jpeg / .webp`; the build picks the newest file per base name, so
no code changes are needed:

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs

readme.section: or keep it rebuilding while you iterate:
readme.text:
npm run watch
```

**Replacing a file alone does not update the running plugin**: art is inlined
into `client.js` at build time, so rebuild first and then reinstall / restart
Harness (a client hot reload may pick it up; otherwise restart). Suggested sizes: `whale` 512 px transparent,
`victory` / `failure` 384 px transparent, `rice` 420 px transparent. See
[`assets/README.md`](assets/README.md).

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/ + assets/ -> client.js
node --test              # 29 tests: game rules, anti-addiction, bundle, UI
npm pack --dry-run       # inspect the exact files that would be published
```

The module id and version inside `client.js` are read from `package.json`;
rebuild after renaming the package or bumping the version.

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half (nothing to serve) |
| `src/core.js` | Pure game and anti-addiction rules |
| `src/render.js` | Canvas scene, text burdens, chibi animation |
| `src/client.template.js` | React overlay, launcher, dialogs, settings |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | Concatenates everything into `client.js` |
| `test/` | `node:test` suites |
| `locale/` | Plugin-manager display metadata (EN / zh) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Plugin row declaration (`name` is the npm package name) |

[MIT](LICENSE). The whale-girl illustrations in `assets/` were generated for
this project; replace them if you redistribute the game with different art.
